evidence_card.name: Event Lottery System
methods: Device-based onboarding and login routes users into entrant, organizer, or admin flows.
Entrants browse, search, filter, join or leave event waitlists, handle invitations, scan QR codes, manage notifications, update profiles, and view event history.
Organizers create and manage events, upload posters, manage waitlists, invite entrants, assign co-organizers, run lottery and replacement draws, view maps, moderate comments, and send notifications.
Admins review and moderate users, organizers, events, comments, and notifications.
Firestore-backed app data includes users, events, notifications, comments, and app configuration collections.
Private event access is controlled through waitlist membership, selection/invitation history, or explicit private waitlist invitations.
Public event links route through a deep-link landing activity while private events are blocked from public landing.
Firebase configuration is expected through app/google-services.json and Firestore app_config documents for admin key and FreeImageHost API key.
Build and install workflows use the Gradle wrapper through assembleDebug and installDebug, with Android Studio also supported.
Unit tests and instrumentation tests cover validators, ranking/filter logic, adapters, models, and entrant/organizer/admin journeys.
Role-based onboarding and login for entrant, organizer, and admin personas.
Device-based identity using Android ID.
Signup flow with validation for details and address.
Role granting for existing users without duplicating user records.
Admin login validation using Firestore app_config/admin_key.
Entrant event browsing with status-aware cards.
Advanced event filtering by capacity, time availability, and eligibility.
Hybrid event search using lexical scoring, synonyms, trigram similarity, and on-device MiniLM ONNX semantic ranking.
Event details page with metadata, poster, organizer name, comments, waitlist actions, invitation actions, and QR dialog.
QR scanning through CameraX with gallery image decode fallback.
